invariants.rationale: Rectangle widths are generally expected to be non-negative, especially as this value might represent a visible area.
Rectangle heights are generally expected to be non-negative, especially as this value might represent a visible area.
Adding width to the starting x should not decrease its value if width is non-negative.
Adding height to the starting y should not decrease its value if height is non-negative.
It is unlikely to be meaningful to try to horizontally center a rectangle of zero width.
